meta.description: Measures how loud a room is, from a small microphone board: the sound level, a spectrum by pitch and a calibrated level in dB SPL.

m5stack-atom-echos3r.description: A palm-sized ESP32-S3 board with a microphone, a sound chip and Wi-Fi, powered over USB.
m5stack-atom-echos3r.does: Runs ESPHome as a room sound sensor. Every second it reports the loudness and the loudest peak, five times a second a spectrum in 31 bands from deep bass to treble, and it can stream a faster reading on demand. It listens only: the speaker amplifier on the board stays off.

ambient_wave.name: Ambient wave
ambient_wave.description: Sound, or any sensor, drawn as calm waves that swell and warm with the level.

error.config: The card configuration must be an object.
error.source_entity: source.entity is required unless source.demo is true.
error.flavour: flavour "{flavour}" is unknown or does not suit source.kind "{kind}".
error.fps: fps must be a number from 1 to 60.
error.axis: source.axis must be "third_octave"; other axes are not supported.
error.show: source.show must be two frequencies in Hz, the lower first, at least one band apart.
error.palette: colour.palette must be zones, series, calm, an entity, or a list of [value, colour] stops with at least one numeric value.
error.history: source.history must be a number of seconds above 0.

fallback.no_data: Sound sensor sends no data: showing the classic wave

room_meter.name: Room meter
room_meter.description: Live sound level: a needle, a peak-hold LED ladder, a strip of recent readings and live tracking.

live.to_slow: Back to one reading a second
live.to_fast: Follow the level ten times a second

room_meter.offset_estimated: Offset estimated: calibrate against a reference meter
